exposure: Combined intervention of quality management (systematic process improvement) and preventive care (complication-focused interventions)
cohort: A total of 130 parturients who underwent cesarean section in a hospital between January 2023 and December 2024.
finding: The combined intervention significantly promotes recovery, reduces pain, enhances disease understanding, and controls maternal infection in cesarean section parturients, while also improving nursing quality, quality of life, and satisfaction.
